confirmed_in_CPU_reproduction: Both exact leaked POSIX semaphore names came from the spawned child constructing its first tqdm: std.py.__new__ -> get_lock -> TqdmDefaultWriteLock.create_mp_lock -> multiprocessing.RLock -> SemLock(kind0). Creation stat inode/ctime matches each later residual and manual recovery.

Actor/driver actual default context was fork, while the explicitly chosen child Process context and the child's actual context were spawn. This was read from the live processes, not inferred from environment variables.

For actor_gc, Ray logs successful kill requests for both the exact progress-child PID and the identified resource_tracker PID before actor __ray_shutdown__ begins. Timestamp resolution is1ms; the hook is approximately2.5ms after the kill log.

The child can still report is_alive=true at callback entry because kill delivery/reaping is asynchronous; its join then reports exitcode-9. No matching cleanup/unregister or tracker cleanup ran, and the exact lock remained.
The explicit close control first permits child normal exit0 and its matching cleanup/unregister; only then is the actor handle released. Ray later kills the tracker but no lock remains.
